measurement.if_gate_fails: Preserve all results and block correction optimizer; no claim of representational impossibility
measurement.if_gate_passes: Compare unprotected vs proximal correction from identical joint states; unchanged target/probe scoring
measurement.ladder_causality: Only adjacent v1_full -> query_full -> concise_full -> concise_table isolate one interface change each
measurement.primary_scope: DEV representational diagnostic and conditional correction/preservation; not full R20 or unbounded continual learning
measurement.resolved_oracle: Oracle-assisted rule selection only; cannot establish learned context selection
measurement.selection: concise_v2 fixed before any result; no selection of interface, seed or checkpoint from heldout performance

system: Apply the requested client's latest learned string formatting rule. If no rule is known for that client, copy the input unchanged. Reply with only the output string, without quotes or explanation.

training.proximal_loss: coefficient * mean((bank - pre_update_bank)^2); anchor transient, not extra persistent state
